site_name: Former News International Site, 1 Virginia Street, London, E98 1XY
description: Application for Non-Material amendment to planning permission ref: PA/19/01684, Dated 29/01/2020. Non Material amendment(s) Sought:We are proposing amendments to the London Dock car parking layout. This revised layout results in a sitewide reduction of 62 parking spaces compared to the currently consented detail. Building G requires a small increase in parking to achieve this; however, all other phases see the number of parking spaces reduced. Whilst not explicit within planning Condition 8, a 10% provision of disabled spaces is implied across the whole basement. This has been maintained within the proposed revised layout. The previous approvals all have sectional plans for the basement. These are to be replaced by an overall basement plan, as the changes are intended to be read as a whole.
